description: This file defines a report parser class for generating VAT declaration reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for retrieving and processing accounting and tax data.

classes.name: tax_report
classes.description: A report parser class for VAT declaration, extending rml_parse.rml_parse, providing methods to generate detailed tax reports.

methods.name: _get_lines
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a list of account lines with tax data, including hierarchical codes and general account info.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Fetches the name of an account period given its ID.

methods.name: _get_general
methods.description: Calculates aggregated tax amounts, debits, credits for a given tax code and period list, optionally filtered by 'payments' or other criteria.

methods.name: _get_codes
methods.description: Recursively retrieves tax codes based on parent-child relationships and company, with indentation levels.

methods.name: _add_codes
methods.description: Adds tax code sums to account list entries based on period list and 'based_on' criteria.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Returns the company name for a given form input.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Returns the currency name for a given company's ID.

methods.name: sort_result
methods.description: Sorts and groups account lines, inserting subtotal lines when hierarchy levels decrease.
